descriptions.completed: I found Nick's ring at the lava cave, and I also collected a number of Cerebes's teeth, getting them all to Scadur. Hopefully Nick will be satisfied with this. I got a cape from Scadur that's been passed down from generation to generation ... this ain't bad at all!
